% The LaTeX half of resume.tex. The resume class declares the résumé
% lineage's zero paragraph skip (moderncv keeps the standard classes' zero
% \parskip), unnumbered headings and no page number; this is an article
% declaring the same three, so what differs is what the classes do with them.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{fontspec}
\setmainfont{OpenSans-Regular.ttf}[Path=../corpus/fonts/, BoldFont=OpenSans-Bold.ttf, ItalicFont=OpenSans-Italic.ttf, BoldItalicFont=OpenSans-BoldItalic.ttf]
\setlength{\parskip}{0pt}
\pagestyle{empty}
\begin{document}
\section*{Alder heading}
Birch is the first entry.

Cedar is the second entry.

\section*{Dogwood heading}
Elm is the entry under the second heading.
\end{document}
